explication: PebbleOS is smartwatch firmware: it hosts watch applications and provides device, connectivity, and user-facing services. A representative runtime path is a running app using firmware services, which in turn interact with device hardware or persistent state. The tree documents these capabilities broadly, but sampled implementation excerpts are mostly storage-focused; edges below emphasize only wiring directly supported by those excerpts, and omit uncertain service-to-service flows.
